mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 PM, we are looking at clear skies and a pleasant 79 degrees near the high school, with a waxing crescent moon starting its cycle tonight.

The Plan Commission has a busy agenda this Tuesday, September 8, including a comprehensive look at various zoning amendments and a pending initial review for the Sub-Zero project at Liberty Business Park.
Today is the Epic User Group Meeting. Looking ahead, tomorrow features trivia nights at Hop Haus Brewing Company and the Wisconsin Brewing Company, plus the downtown farmer's market on Wednesday.

The Verona Police Department reported a few notable calls this past week, including an arrest on Saturday, August 15, where a driver was taken into custody for a second offence O W I, along with several other traffic citations.

Treat yourself to the Caramel Peanut Buttercup flavor of the day at Culver's, which is open until 10 PM tonight. Also, don't forget to stop by the Kona Ice truck at the Concerts at McKee event today between 5 PM and 9 PM.
